name: Torrents Manager
description: A simple web application to manage qBittorrent upload settings based on time of day.
requires:
Requires a separate qBittorrent instance. 
        [br]
        Recommended to run via a cron schedule (e.g. Ofelia)

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Path to the data directory for Torrents Manager

variables.name: qBittorrent - URL
variables.description: URL of the qBittorrent Web UI

variables.name: qBittorrent - Username
variables.description: Username for the qBittorrent Web UI

variables.name: qBittorrent - Password
variables.description: Password for the qBittorrent Web UI

variables.name: Schedule - Night Start
variables.description: Start time for the night schedule (HH:MM format)

variables.name: Schedule - Night End
variables.description: End time for the night schedule (HH:MM format)

variables.name: Schedule - Max Uploads Day
variables.description: Maximum number of uploads allowed during the day (0 for unlimited)

variables.name: Schedule - Max Uploads Night
variables.description: Maximum number of uploads allowed during the night (0 for unlimited)
